caption: The drawing depicts a round sieve featuring a thick, light grayish-blue wooden frame with visible grain texture. Inside the frame, there is a grid of brown, unevenly spaced strands forming a square mesh pattern. The strands intersect to create small square openings across the surface, and the frame appears slightly tilted, showing both the inner and outer rims. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or patterns present. There is a small, faint handwritten inscription including a name and date in the lower center area below the object.
title: Lead Miner's Screen
